solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Man and boy, he was known for his strength

definitions.text: he was known for his strength

parts.note: Sam is a man's name, a common short form of Samuel
a son is a boy, someone's male child

explanation.surface: A father and son team, one of whom was famous for being strong.
explanation.walkthrough: The Biblical strongman whose power lay in his uncut hair.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament judge whose legendary physical might ended when Delilah had his hair cut.

clue.text: Origins of Crusoe's shipwreck?

indicators.note: a wrecked ship is smashed apart, so the letters of the castaway's name are broken up and rebuilt

parts.note: the possessive S is kept here as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: What were the beginnings of the famous castaway's ill-fated voyage?
explanation.walkthrough: Here the 'S of Crusoe's counts as a letter, which is unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: origins and beginnings are the places things spring from.

clue.text: Mischief-maker intended to limit one's credit

indicators.note: to limit something is to hem it in, so the word for intended encloses the other pieces

parts.note: if you intended something, you meant it
one is I, and 'one's' is read as I plus S
CR is the standard abbreviation for credit in accounts

explanation.surface: A troublemaker who set out to restrict someone's borrowing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' is read as one (I) plus S rather than as a possessive; 'limit' looks like credit control but is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscreant is a wrongdoer or villain, someone who causes mischief.

clue.text: Holiday when one is not at one's best

definitions.meaning: read the other way round, a day off from work

definitions.text: when one is not at one's best
definitions.meaning: a day of poor performance when nothing goes right

explanation.definitionFit: The hyphenated phrase means a bad day, and reversed as a day off it suggests a day away from work.

clue.text: Value a quiet compliment

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly
praise is a compliment, words of approval

explanation.surface: A softly spoken word of flattery is worth having.
explanation.definitionFit: To value goods is to assess their worth, as an appraiser or valuer does.

clue.text: Not all an unemployed actor hopes for

definitions.meaning: a portion rather than the whole
a role in a play or film, what an actor out of work longs to be offered

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a fraction of something and a role an actor is cast in.

clue.text: Hard time obtaining dietary fibre

parts.note: a hard time is a rough one; rough also means harsh
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Going through a difficult spell while trying to eat more fibre.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughage is the indigestible plant material in food that nutritionists call fibre.

clue.text: He's one to do it wrongly

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

indicators.note: doing something wrongly gets it out of order, so these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man known for bungling every task he takes on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly' rearranges DO IT into DIOT, which follows I; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A fool is the kind of person the clue describes, someone who does things badly.

clue.text: One hears about a murder

indicators.note: about here means turned around or reorganised, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A witness picks up news of a killing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One hears' reads as a person listening, but the definition is the organ that hears.
explanation.definitionFit: The membrane in the ear that vibrates with sound is the means by which a person hears.

clue.text: Unreliable fuse, an explosion reveals

indicators.note: an explosion blows things apart, so these letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A blast shows the fuse was faulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reveals' is a link word joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unsafe is risky and cannot be relied on, like a dodgy fuse.

clue.text: He rakes in the money while others take risks

definitions.text: He rakes in the money while others take risks

parts.words: He rakes in the money while others take risks
parts.note: the casino employee who gathers chips from the table with a rake while gamblers place bets

explanation.surface: A man who profits while everyone else gambles.
explanation.definitionFit: The casino attendant literally rakes in the stakes with a long-handled rake at the gaming table.

clue.text: Frightened by a number with guns

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a number
someone carrying guns is armed

explanation.surface: Scared by a crowd of people carrying weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarmed means scared or anxious, as when danger appears.

clue.text: Shortens dog-ends?

parts.note: a cur is a dog, usually a mongrel
tails are the ends of things

explanation.surface: Cuts down cigarette butts, slang dog-ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog-ends' is British slang for cigarette butts; here it splits into a dog and its ends.
explanation.definitionFit: To curtail something is to cut it short or reduce it.

clue.text: More like the snow I threw out?

indicators.note: out here means put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone tossed a snowball that was paler than the snow?
explanation.definitionFit: Snow is the standard of paleness, so something more like it is paler.

clue.text: Commercials about fitting suits

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the word for commercials goes around the other piece

parts.note: ads are commercials, advertisements
just means fitting or deserved, as in a just reward

explanation.surface: Adverts concerning tailored clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suits' looks like a noun for clothes but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To suit something is to adapt it, which is to adjust or fit it to a purpose.

clue.text: Strike action when mates are sent back

indicators.note: something sent back goes in the reverse direction, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: mates are pals, friends

explanation.surface: Industrial action when colleagues are dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strike action' suggests a walkout but means a blow; 'when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack with the open hand is a kind of blow or hit.

clue.text: Man of the match

parts.note: the match is a marriage, and the man in it is the groom

explanation.surface: The award for the best player in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A wedding is a match between two people, and the man being married is its central male figure.

clue.text: Relation seen in public performance

indicators.note: something seen in another is contained within it

parts.note: open means public, available to all
a ratio is a relation between two quantities

explanation.surface: A relative spotted at a public show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relation' suggests a family member but is mathematical.
explanation.definitionFit: An operation is the performance of a task or the working of a machine.

clue.text: Has encircled round troubled country

indicators.note: the word written first wraps around what follows
troubled means disturbed, so the letters of the word are disturbed

explanation.surface: A troubled nation has been surrounded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troubled country' looks like the definition phrase, but 'troubled' belongs to the wordplay and 'country' stands alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A Central American nation bordered by Guatemala, El Salvador and Nicaragua.

clue.text: Successfully concluded business in a taciturn manner

definitions.meaning: a deal that is ... is settled and finished

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both settled and complete, and reticent or uncommunicative.

clue.text: Region that is not a party to the Convention

definitions.meaning: a historic area of the Czech Republic

definitions.text: that is not a party to the Convention

explanation.definitionFit: A western Czech region whose name gave us bohemian, for people who reject convention.

clue.text: Bank gives free change

indicators.note: to change the letters is to rearrange them

explanation.surface: A bank offers free change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' looks like a financial institution but is a ridge of sand or rock; 'gives' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A reef is a ridge of rock, sand or coral near the water's surface, a kind of bank.

clue.text: Plant making two light carriages

parts.note: a fly was a light one-horse carriage for hire
a trap is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage

explanation.surface: A factory building a pair of small horse-drawn vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' suggests a factory but is a carnivorous plant; 'making' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Venus flytrap is a plant that snaps shut on insects to digest them.

clue.text: Flying force possibly set out to attack

indicators.note: out here means out of place, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the RAF, Royal Air Force, is one example of a flying force

explanation.surface: An air squadron may have left to launch an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: To strafe is to attack ground targets with gunfire from low-flying aircraft.

clue.text: Perhaps Hudson Bay may have come from one of these

definitions.text: Bay may have come from one of these

indicators.note: perhaps signals the name is one possible arrangement of other letters

parts.note: hunting dogs bay, and their name's letters rearrange into the river's

explanation.surface: Wondering where the great Canadian bay got its name from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hudson Bay' reads as the Canadian bay, but bay is the cry of hunting dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunting dogs bay as they chase quarry, so a bay comes from these animals.

clue.text: Not above using two foreign articles

parts.note: un is the French indefinite article, a
der is the German definite article, the

explanation.surface: Not too proud to use words borrowed from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not above' sounds like a moral judgement, but is the position; 'using' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Below something is the opposite of over it, the opposite of above.

clue.text: Solid achievements by men good at figures?

definitions.text: Solid achievements by men good at figures?

parts.words: Solid achievements by men good at figures?
parts.note: men good at figures are sculptors, whose solid works are carved figures

explanation.surface: The tangible results of accountants' work.
explanation.definitionFit: Statues collectively are the three-dimensional works sculptors produce.

clue.text: Trouble in sight

parts.note: an ailment affecting the eye, the organ of sight

explanation.surface: Problems are looming ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflamed swelling on the eyelid is a trouble right by the eye.

clue.text: Reduce speed, after a fashion

indicators.note: the second word comes after the first in the answer

parts.note: a mode is a fashion or style
rate means speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: Slow down, more or less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after a fashion' reads as 'more or less', but 'after' is the charade order signal and 'a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To moderate something is to lessen its intensity, to tone it down.

clue.text: Millionaire's roe?

parts.note: punning on a millionaire's row of mansions, the fish eggs that rich people eat

explanation.surface: A street where the rich live.
explanation.definitionFit: Sturgeon eggs are a costly luxury, the fish roe of the wealthy.

clue.text: Such gear is required to check naval aircraft

definitions.text: Such gear is required to check naval aircraft

parts.words: Such gear is required to check naval aircraft
parts.note: the cable system on a carrier deck that stops planes as they land

explanation.surface: Equipment for inspecting warplanes.
explanation.definitionFit: The wires that catch a landing plane's hook on an aircraft carrier are known by this name.

clue.text: Satisfactorily completed some mending?

definitions.meaning: settled and secured, as a deal that is in the bag
literally stitched closed with needle and thread

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a matter is settled, and literally means stitched shut.
